titulo: Far-right AfD celebrate ‘dream result’ in key German state as Merz reportedly holds crisis talks – Europe live
cuerpo: Group fail to secure majority in Saxony-Anhalt state parliament leaving uncertainty over next steps Far-right AfD wins key German state election but falls just short of majority AfD’s Chrupalla continues in this vein, saying the German public wants to see a change in direction, and specifically saying the electorate is “fed up” as the government keeps “transferring billions of our tax money to Ukraine … instead of using it for our own population.” He says the party has “a clear mandate” to rule in Saxony-Anhalt and will hold discussions with others about what can be done.
